sub_questions.question: Is there a cap on how many API calls can be made per month on the free plan?

claims.claim: Sandbox (free) workspaces are capped at 5,000 API calls per month.
claims.guide_evidence: | Sandbox | Free | 200 credits, one-time (does not renew) | 1 | 5 | 50 | 50 MB | 5,000 calls/month |

claims.claim: Upgrading to Professional or Team removes the Dify-imposed API rate limit entirely.
claims.guide_evidence: | Professional | $59/workspace/month ($590/year) | 5,000 credits/month | 3 | 50 | 500 | 5 GB | No Dify-imposed API rate limit |

claims.claim: The user is on, or is asking about, a Sandbox workspace (free plan equals Sandbox).

evaluation.rationale: The answer correctly states the Sandbox 5,000 calls/month cap and that Professional and Team have no Dify-imposed API rate limit, both stated in the guide's plan table. It is complete, appropriately scoped, and professional in tone.
